profile.headline: Full-stack | Software Programmer | UI/UX Developer
profile.summary:
Software Developer leveraging extensive experience in programming, project coordination, and
UI/UX design to deliver high-quality software solutions and seamless user experiences across fast-paced
organizations. Versatile problem-solver with a proven history of navigating evolving requirements,
mastering new technologies, and consistently exceeding expectations. Dedicated leader committed to
improving team performance and productivity through the comprehensive documentation of standard
operating procedures, ensuring consistency, clarity, and overall operational efficiency.

Areas of Expertise:
- Front-end Development
- Cross-functional Collaboration
- Technical Documentation
- Testing & Quality Assurance
- Project Management
- Process Improvement
- UI/UX Design
- Technical Troubleshooting
- Mentoring & Training

positions.title: Freelance Software Developer
positions.description:
Programmer: AI Trainer
- Evaluate code quality produced by AI models for correctness and performance.
- Develop high-quality answers and code snippets in multiple languages including Python and Javascript.

Web Developer
- WordPress Management

positions.title: Mid Level Software Developer
positions.description:
• Enhanced existing functionalities, developed new features, and automated product creation processes,
bolstering production efficiency and refining data visualization for enhanced clarity and precision.
• Spearheaded the development of a SKU generation feature, facilitating swift and seamless product
creation by enabling the generation of unique SKUs, variations, and new SKU properties.
• Engineered and deployed user-centric management CRUD webpages, reducing production user reliance on manual intervention.
• Led comprehensive UI redesign efforts aimed at modernizing legacy processes, resulting in an
intuitive interface that empowered users to effortlessly execute bulk actions and navigate tasks.
• Streamlined legacy processes, significantly enhancing data handling capabilities, with a notable
improvement in loading runtime and elimination of crashes during large order processing.
• Adapted to evolving requirements by conducting revisions, repairs, or expansions of existing
projects to optimize code readability and support maintainability.
• Received a promotion due to a proven track record of independently initiating and completing
multiple complex projects with minimal oversight or guidance.

positions.title: QA Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Verified software quality and functionality in alignment with task requirements by managing test
cases and executing test plans for system regression, GUI, and load cases.
•  Identified and eliminated potential bugs by updating weekly software release plans.
•  Oversaw clients throughout the integration process, developing automated scripts to parse data, process new
accounts, and manage existing accounts, successfully increasing accuracy and efficiency.
•  Supported new hire onboarding and training while also maintaining updated records for developers
by creating detailed documentation on revised SOPs.

positions.title: Junior Software Developer
positions.description:
• Developed an understanding of QCC at a high level to provide a faster, cheaper, and more efficient alternative to court docket monitoring for attorneys
• Scraped desired data from HTML/CSS, JavaScript, and JSON web pages by creating web automation.
• Improved code by effectively removing duplications and refactoring existing code.
• Participated in daily Scrum meetings, reviewing project progress, goals, and development status.
• Established technical documentation for new developers, covering topics such as creating new
plugins, adjusting configuration files, deploying to AWS services, and utilizing IIS; contributed to
enhancing knowledge sharing and team productivity.

positions.title: Student Programmer Intern
positions.description:
• Lead Android developer responsible for the overall development of a music theory app using Java and Android Studio
• Designed a mock-up UI/UX for the beta using Adobe Illustrator
• Wrote a technical documentation noting goals, features and functionalities, project updates, current bugs, and testing results for future developers
• Provided advice/solutions to complex technical issues
• Participated in furthering the technological aspect of the company by continuously engaging in scrum meetings to discuss the curriculums and growth of young students interested in learning programming

volunteerExperiences.description:
Courses taught:
• Python Turtle: Introductory
• Python: Introductory and OOP
• Data Science (Python Programming): Introductory

Responsibilities:
• Assisted in writing a simple, readable user manual and system configuration guide for teachers and system administrators within an established deadline
• Meticulously tested, documented, and created quality screenshots related

Goals:
• To develop a clear understanding of different features/functionalities within the Salesforce app
• To ensure that each final document not only provides a vision of the product but teaches in a step-by-step fashion for users of all levels

organizations.name: Global Connections Partner
organizations.description:
 Established a peer-to-peer connection with an international student
 Encouraged cultural exploration to help student build solid relationships in their new environment
 Organized weekly activities to provide a welcoming experience for the student

organizations.name: Young Aspiring Writers With Power
organizations.description:
 Helped the president plan weekly club meetings and prepare for club activities
 Ordered and helped organize items used for the club fundraiser
 Collected and organized writing pieces to design the end-of-year club magazine, "Breaking Through the Ink"
